description:
First bot hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses, farms and structure verification construction sites.

What must be true first: the assembler arms results have to replicate outside the lab, bot logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and docking precision operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed assembler arms demonstrations, bot logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting docking precision uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Orbital Assembly Bots
definition: Estimates Orbital Assembly Bots readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Orbital Assembly Bots components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a bot hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Orbital Assembly Bots Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Orbital Assembly Bots operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Orbital Assembly Bots installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 56857 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where assembler arms monitoring, bot logistics redundancy, or docking precision maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Orbital Assembly Bots Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Orbital Assembly Bots: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Orbital Assembly Bots — bots assembling giant structures in orbit.

Phase 1 — Prove (assembler arms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (bot logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (docking precision): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (structure verification): bot hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and orbit-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
